In this video we cover:
EU Sanctions Target Indian Refinery Over Russian Oil Links
The EU’s latest sanctions on Russian oil have directly impacted India by targeting Nayara Energy’s Gujarat refinery, partly owned by Russia’s Rosneft. This move could derail Rosneft’s stake sale to Reliance and disrupt India’s oil exports to Europe. The video explores how this decision affects India’s refining business, energy security, and global oil trade dynamics.
